component.name: pd200x-control
component.summary: Control the Maono PD200X and PD200XS microphone

description.p: pd200x-control sets everything MAONO Link sets on the Maono PD200X and PD200XS USB microphones, on Linux: gain, mute, headphone monitoring, noise cancellation, the EQ profiles, a 7-band parametric EQ, compressor, limiter and the RGB ring light.

ul.li: A live level meter that shows where your voice peaks
The system microphone volume up to 200 % for quiet dynamic microphones
Find my level: gain and volume from five seconds of speech
A test recording through PipeWire, to hear yourself as others hear you

description.p: The microphone needs a udev rule on the host once, so your user may open it; the app shows the commands.

screenshot.caption: Live level, gain, system microphone volume and monitoring
EQ profiles and the 7-band parametric EQ
